question.problem: If $[a]_{n}$ denotes the residue class containing all integers congruent to $a$ modulo $n,$ then $[-17]_{8}=$
question.worked_solution:
We have $[a]_{8}=[b]_{8}$ if 

$$
a≡b\,(\text{mod}\,8).
$$

The residue class $[-17]_{8}$ consists of the elements that are congruent to $-17$ modulo $8.$ 

We can find an alternative representation for this residue class as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}[-17]_{8} & ={x\in Z\,|\,x≡-17\,(\text{mod}\,8)} \\  & ={x\in Z\,|\,x≡(-3)\cdot 8+7\,(\text{mod}\,8)} \\  & ={x\in Z\,|\,x≡(-3)\cdot 0+7\,(\text{mod}\,8)} \\  & ={x\in Z\,|\,x≡7\,(\text{mod}\,8)} \\  & =[7]_{8}\end{aligned}
$$
